The Demazure-Lusztig operator (eigenvalues q, -1/q; eigenvalue-sum = h, the KC18 odd-channel carrier) has length-2 character magnitude <= q0^2 ~ 1.23, so reaching |Σ| ~ 40 needs ~32 length-2 Weyl elements ⇒ rank n >= 9 -- physically absurd for a nucleon (H_3/H_4 Hecke, rank 3-4). Combined with N1-N3 + Lusztig 1990 positivity, the physically-motivated Demazure-Lusztig family does NOT escape. Unphysical-rank / unnatural-magnitude conventions are not excluded (scope-(a), not a convention-independent impossibility proof) but are categorically unmotivated and, per KC18, unnecessary.
